name: Helping The Helpless
overview: Scripture reveals God's heart for those who are helpless, calling His people to advocate for the voiceless and defend those facing destruction, as seen in Proverbs 31:8. God Himself is described as a refuge and strength for the poor and needy in distress (Isaiah 25:4), demonstrating His compassion toward the weak. Christ’s ministry included delivering the dumb from demonic oppression (Luke 11:14), and His sacrificial death on behalf of the ungodly and sinners (Romans 5:6, 8) exemplifies the ultimate help extended to the helpless. Believers are also reminded to value and protect the vulnerable, especially the 'little ones,' whose angels behold the Father’s face in heaven (Matthew 18:10).
